name: BSP_LuaBinding_ScoringIsUnlocked
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the error literal in the body is "luaMW_Scoring_IsUnlocked failed:". Reads argument 0 as a Lua string, wraps it with BSP_NativeString_Assign and returns 007FC4C0's result to Lua, so Scoring_IsUnlocked is the script-side name of the unlock predicate. Shipped mission scripts call it with medal ids: IsUnlocked("JM2_GOLD"), IsUnlocked("JM6_SILVER"), IsUnlocked("JM6_BRONZE"). See docs/PROFILE_UNLOCK_PREDICATE.md.
